purpose: Define the minimum, category-only evidence record for a single proposed end-to-end personal-data flow and recipient relationship. The template is product- and domain-neutral and fails closed; it does not establish a processing register, a runtime data path, a disclosure, a transfer, or a legal outcome.

included: one proposed artifact and deployment reference
one immutable authenticated Tenant and Area scope reference pair
one proposed source-to-recipient personal-data flow described only by categories and evidence references
one linked RoPA evidence intake record
excluded: real personal data, identifiers, credentials, prompts, or Memory Core payloads
runtime routing, storage, disclosure, transfer, or external effects
a production processing register, legal determination, or compliance certification
authority, policy, approval, release, or capability activation

scope_binding_requirements: Authenticated Tenant and Area scope references are immutable review evidence and cannot establish, expand, replace, or override trusted runtime context.
Every source, flow segment, recipient, subprocessor, location, transfer boundary, retention rule, and safeguard reference must bind to the same immutable authenticated Tenant and Area scope pair.

A record may not be reused across Tenant or Area boundaries; cross-boundary flow requires independently authenticated, scope-bound evidence for every participating boundary and separately governed qualified review.
The template stores only categories, identifiers, digests, and evidence references; it must not contain raw personal data, direct identifiers, credentials, secrets, prompts, or memory payloads.

A flow is incomplete unless every required source, category, purpose, immutable scope, recipient, transfer boundary, retention, safeguard, and evidence reference is present, immutable, current, internally consistent, and scope-matched.
Unknown, unverified, unavailable, or deployment-specific facts must remain explicit release stops with an accountable owner and an unblock condition; they must never be inferred or defaulted.
evidence_linking_requirements: The record must link to one scope-matched RoPA evidence intake record and must not replace it.
Every claimed end-to-end flow segment must cite immutable source, lineage, recipient, location or transfer, retention, safeguard, and review evidence references.
The qualified reviewer and review date are review inputs only and do not create a legal, policy, authority, processing, disclosure, transfer, or release decision.

template_is_not: a legal opinion, data-transfer determination, data-protection impact assessment, or compliance certification
a repository record containing real personal data or a production processing or recipient register
an authenticated Tenant, Area, Project, Session, principal, role, authority, approval, policy, or runtime context
a runtime data-flow, processing, transfer, disclosure, storage, or deletion instruction
a processing, deployment, productive-use, or release approval
a runtime capability enablement or external-effect authorization
authority_boundary.protected_control_plane_boundary: No content in this template can bypass or replace authenticated identity, immutable scope, policy, approvals, transition gates, fences, kill switches, sandboxing, independent verification, or atomic audit evidence.
authority_boundary.release_boundary: A complete record is review evidence only. It never activates a runtime path, authorizes a transfer or disclosure, establishes a processing fact, resolves a release stop, or changes the current Memory Core foundation maturity.

unblock_condition: A concrete proposed deployment supplies a complete immutable record for each claimed source-to-recipient flow, with authenticated scope-bound evidence references, linked RoPA intake, category-level facts, qualified review inputs, and separately governed decisions where required.
